caption:
The Fed hit pause. 🏦
On Oct 28 it kept its key rate at 3.75%–4%. Two officials voted to raise it instead.
Why it matters: that rate shapes what you pay on credit cards, car loans and variable debt.
Has the rate environment changed any money decision you've made this year?
